newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria to issue CA memo on Oct 21.
newsitem.headline: Austria to issue CA memo on Oct 21.

text.p: Austrian Finance Minister Viktor Klima said on Friday the government would issue an updated memorandum on Creditanstalt-Bankverein to interested parties on October 21.
He told Reuters that the release would be followed by a four-week bidding period.

"Our goal remains to sell the state's entire stake. But the memorandum is phrased in such a way that it will not place too many restrictions on potential investors," Klima said, adding that it did not stipulate a minimum volume.
He said the memorandum updated a report last year by U.S. investment house JP Morgan but he insisted it was not a fresh valuation.
"We have updated the memorandum with Creditanstalt's latest results but it is not a new valuation. There is nothing that we need to publish," Klima said.
Potential investors would be given full access to all relevant information by the finance ministry and Creditanstalt, he said.
Austria has been trying to offload its 70 percent of Creditanstalt ordinary shares for six years, so far without success.
